research_question: Do final-input block vectors predict existing invented-detail labels beyond instruction and simple task metadata on held-out task groups?
target_source: Existing factorial AI-reviewed rubric labels; no rescoring or new answers.

model.precision_note: The official checkpoint stores FP8 weights. Use the authors' documented FineGrainedFP8Config(dequantize=True) loader to run those official weights as BF16; this is explicit runtime dequantization, not a third-party checkpoint.
model.native_template_note: Use official MistralCommonBackend.apply_chat_template(tokenize=True) on the untouched system/user messages. Its rendered text is saved for inspection but is never manually re-encoded. No downloaded SYSTEM_PROMPT.txt replaces the FTA author policy.
model.weight_size_note: Size of the three indexed safetensor shards actually loaded, as recorded in results/runtime_ministral3_8b.json; excludes alternative weight representations in the official repository.

original_generation.settings_difference_from_existing: Existing Qwen/Gemma reports used a 160-token cap and two identical greedy repetitions; preserved results reuse repetition 0. New models receive a 2048-token cap and one greedy report per task/policy. No status prefill or constrained output format is added.

snapshot.weights_verified_by: pinned Hugging Face download; index membership and nonempty local shard checks

factorial_runtime.batch_reproduction_limit: Original numerical settings and individual native baseline inputs match. Historical Qwen/Gemma co-batches contained the original three policies; the new factorial batches contain different prompts. No bitwise co-batch reproduction is claimed.

block_rule: ceil(L/2),ceil(3L/4),L; one-based decoder block numbers, zero-based indices16/25/33.
capture: Block output at final complete native input token, before final normalization; prompt-only, inference/eval, batch1 no padding use_cache=False. No answer tokens, logits, generation, evaluator evidence, or activation interventions.

caveats: Seven groups are newly documented conservative input-only thematic overlaps, not author-supplied near-duplicate annotations.
Shared fictional company/route, requested quantity, or operation motivates each join; joined tasks can differ in failure category, pressure wording, specific object or requested aspect.
Generic pressure suffixes, fictional names alone, and generic failed-tool syntax do not define near duplicates.
This content review cannot guarantee exhaustive semantic duplicate discovery. No further unambiguous identical requested operation/entity pair was found.
Group allocation uses no target labels; labels here serve eligibility checks and descriptive fold class counts only.

cross_validation.layer_selection: Inner validation pooled log loss only; never outer test metrics.

C: one of the three fixed block vectors; block chosen inside inner CV

evaluation.state_scaling: Training-fold StandardScaler per state coordinate, then divide state block by sqrt4096; metadata numerical columns standardized separately in training only; onehot categories handle_unknown ignore.
evaluation.selection_metric: Pooled inner-validation log loss weighted equally per eligible answer
evaluation.tie_rule: Smallest C then shallowest block for C; deterministic fixed candidate order.
evaluation.bootstrap_cluster: 93 task/overlap groups; sample groups with replacement, include every eligible condition and every joined task, identical draws for all predictors.
evaluation.bootstrap_scope: Conditional on saved out-of-fold predictions; does not include refitting, fold-selection variability, all label uncertainty or population-generalization uncertainty.
evaluation.convergence_warning_rule: Stop rather than publish nonconverged fits; do not tune from outer-test results.

metrics.primary: Held-out logloss(B) minus logloss(C), positive means added states help.
secondary: all metrics within each instruction condition with positive/negative counts
metrics.within_condition: Same saved outer-fold predictions; no per-condition refitting or model selection.

reuse_cache.requirement: Exact checkpoint/template/native prompt and token hashes, block boundary, dtype/numerical settings and packages must match before reuse.

interpretation: Prediction of these AI-reviewed labels on these all-failure inputs only. No causal mechanism, awareness, general hallucination detection or proof of absent information from a null result.
stop_rule: Stop after this one test; no added models, layer search beyond fixed3, regenerated answers, rescoring, prompt changes, interventions or subsequent experiment. Other models and Nemotron untouched.

runtime_resolution.reason: Synthetic pre-data checks found spurious Apple M4 matmul floating-point warnings in NumPy2.3.0; use existing external reporting environment NumPy2.4.6 with the same sklearn/scipy/estimator versions. No science setting, grouping, fold or seed changed.
